Serrated Washer

Serrated Washer

A washer with radially arranged spiral (swirl-shaped) teeth on its inner edge, which dig into the clamped surface to prevent loosening when bolts or nuts are tightened. It resists loosening from vibration better than an ordinary spring washer.

涡形锁紧垫圈
